rows.text: board meets 24-Nov to take on record the NCLT order of 5-Nov sanctioning its amalgamation with Maple Hotels & Resorts.
certified copy received of the NCLT Kolkata order (5-Nov) sanctioning its amalgamation into Maple Hotels & Resorts; effective once filed with the RoC, record date for share allotment to follow.
